mechanism_of_action: Dual GLP-1 and glucagon receptor agonist.
primary_endpoint: Changes in HbA1c and body weight at week 14.
efficacy_outcome: Cotadutide significantly decreased HbA1c and body weight versus placebo at weeks 14 and 54 (all P < 0.001).
safety_signal: The most common adverse events with cotadutide were nausea (35%) and vomiting (17%); these decreased over time.
